description: Keyword suggestions for a website or one page: the Google searches relevant to it, each with search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and search intent; up to 100 in one $0.04 call (Google Ads data). Use when you need keyword ideas from a domain (www. is dropped) or a page URL. A site with no data returns empty results (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

limit.description: Maximum keywords to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).

target.description: targetType site: a bare domain like example.com (no scheme or path; a leading www. is dropped). targetType page: an absolute http(s) page URL.

targetType.description: Suggest keywords for the whole site (default) or only the target page.

name: keywords_for_site
title: Keywords for a site or page (up to 100)
